summary: G405: SCORING ELEMENTS that leave the FIELD because a ROBOT blocked another ROBOT's scoring attempt are not deliberate ejections. R612: sliding contacts and slip rings on critical power paths must be unmodified COTS; custom ones are prohibited. Also T402 (REFEREES may only DISABLE a ROBOT as a consequence of a rule violation; not covered on this site).

edits.old: during scoring attempts or as the result of ROBOT-to-ROBOT interactions
edits.new: during scoring attempts, as the result of a ROBOT blocking another ROBOT’s scoring attempt, or as the result of ROBOT-to-ROBOT interactions

edits.old: D. power regulating devices and actuators.
edits.new:
D. power regulating devices and actuators.

Dynamic electrical interfaces (including linear sliding contacts) or continuous-rotation electrical interfaces (including slip rings) placed along any of these pathways must be unmodified COTS items; custom or fabricated electrical interfaces of this type are prohibited.
